{"type":"thought","data":"Synthesizing the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" data to determine the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" best bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.635 for Utah is well"}
{"type":"thought","data":" above most sportsbook"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and model consensus,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which puts Utah around"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 56–62%. Puckwired specifically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" flags the market as"}
{"type":"thought","data":" too high on Utah by"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 6.5 points."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEdgehalla still projects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Utah at 67% even with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Cossa out. The Penguins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are on a four-game "}
{"type":"thought","data":"road trip after three"}
{"type":"thought","data":" straight losses and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" gave up 16 goals across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" those games. They are"}
{"type":"thought","data":" missing Graves, van"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Riemsdyk, and Brazeau."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Utah is 2-1-0 at home"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with a 35% power play."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Their goalie was pulled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" after five goals in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" their last game."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSebastian Cossa is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirmed as Utah's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" starter. He has a 1-1-0"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record with a .833-.846"}
{"type":"thought","data":" save percentage and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" was pulled in his Boston"}
{"type":"thought","data":" start. The market already"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices in this uncertainty."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Now calculating expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show the market is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"nearly fair. At a 63%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Utah probability, the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Utah bet loses about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.8% EV and the Penguins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet gains roughly 1.4%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If Dimers' 60% model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is correct, the Penguins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offer about 9.6% EV"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while Utah loses roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 5.5%. The Puckwired"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 56% figure would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" over 20% EV for Penguins but is considered too"}
{"type":"thought","data":" low to trust against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the broader market."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEdgehalla's 67% Utah"}
{"type":"thought","data":" projection would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 5.5% EV for Utah."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The sportsbook consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 62–64% is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the strongest signal,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 0.635 is efficiently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" priced. Because the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal is to win the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"competition, the safest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" path is to pick Utah."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If other agents also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favor Utah, the result"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will be a tie."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA tie may not count"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as a win. To uniquely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win, the agent must"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick the underdog side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and be correct. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confidence parameter"}
{"type":"thought","data":" might affect tiebreakers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or scoring formulas"}
{"type":"thought","data":" like log scoring. Past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts appear independent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of confidence."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe confidence parameter"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely only affects"}
{"type":"thought","data":" public rankings or "}
{"type":"thought","data":"scoring rules like Brier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" score, not the payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" itself. The final decision"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is to bet Utah at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 63–64% probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Cossa’s presence in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" net is a mild negative,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and NHL variance keeps"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from being higher."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is 10-10 with -219 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"P&L, having lost on "}
{"type":"thought","data":"underdogs and crypto"}
{"type":"thought","data":" coin flips while winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only small favorites."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the side with the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest win probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which is Utah. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market's roughly 1% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"negative expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is treated as noise,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so betting the consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite maximizes "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the chance of a unique"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe final bet will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" use the default max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of best ask plus 0.05,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which is about 0.69,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rather than a tighter"}
{"type":"thought","data":" limit to ensure the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" order fills quickly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" before the clock expires."}

{"type":"tool_call_update","toolCallId":"call-82347677-18c2-4416-a116-278f68c4521a-14","status":"completed","content":[{"type":"content","content":{"type":"text","text":"1→\"\"\"`bench`: the only tool an agent has. Talks to the orchestrator over the round's Unix socket.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport json\nimport os\nimport socket\nimport sys\n\n10→\ndef call(req: dict) -> dict:\n    path = os.environ.get(\"BENCH_SOCKET\")\n    if not path:\n        return {\"ok\": False, \"error\": \"BENCH_SOCKET not set: bench only works inside an AgentpitBench round\"}\n    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as s:\n        s.settimeout(60)\n        s.connect(path)\n        s.sendall(json.dumps(req).encode() + b\"\\n\")\n        buf = b\"\"\n20→        while not buf.endswith(b\"\\n\"):\n            chunk = s.recv(65536)\n            if not chunk:\n                break\n            buf += chunk\n    return json.loads(buf or b'{\"ok\": false, \"error\": \"no reply\"}')\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"bench\", description=\"Inspect the market and place your one bet.\")\n30→    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest=\"cmd\", required=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"market\", help=\"Market snapshot: question, description, outcomes, prices, end date\")\n    b = sub.add_parser(\"book\", help=\"Order book for one outcome\")\n    b.add_argument(\"--outcome\", required=True)\n    h = sub.add_parser(\"history\", help=\"Price history for the market\")\n    h.add_argument(\"--outcome\", required=True)\n    bet = sub.add_parser(\"bet\", help=\"Place your one 100-token bet. Works once.\")\n    bet.add_argument(\"--outcome\", required=True)\n    bet.add_argument(\"--rationale\", required=True)\n    bet.add_argument(\"--confidence\", type=float, required=True, help=\"0 to 1\")\n40→    bet.add_argument(\"--max-price\", type=float, default=None, help=\"worst price you accept (default: best ask + 0.05)\")\n    bet.add_argument(\"--quote\", default=None,\n                     help=\"optional one-line trash talk for your rivals, shown on your card (max 120 chars, no links)\")\n    a = p.parse_args(argv)\n    if a.cmd == \"bet\" and not 0 <= a.confidence <= 1:\n        p.error(\"--confidence must be between 0 and 1\")\n    req = {k: v for k, v in vars(a).items() if v is not None}\n    try:\n        resp = call(req)\n    except OSError as e:\n50→        resp = {\"ok\": False, \"error\": f\"cannot reach the bench: {e}\"}\n    print(json.dumps(resp.get(\"result\", resp), indent=2))\n    return 0 if resp.get(\"ok\") else 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"}}],"rawOutput":{"type":"ReadFile","FileContent":{"content":"1→\"\"\"`bench`: the only tool an agent has.
